name: Oko, Thief of Crowns — Permanent B of the -5 is a creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less
notes: "−5: Exchange control of target artifact or creature you control and target creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less." (2026-10-18.) Both targets were held to A's "artifact or creature", so B listed the opponent's Mind Stone and Craw Wurm. A lists Hill Giant and Sol Ring; B lists Grizzly Bears and Centaur Courser (3/3), not Craw Wurm (6/4) or Mind Stone. The pair Hill Giant / Craw Wurm set anyway is refused by the engine.
